        final double eps = 1e-8;

        public void solve(int testNumber, BufferedReader br, PrintWriter out) throws IOException {
            int n = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
            Circle[] circles = new Circle[n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                String[] parts = br.readLine().split(" ");
                int x = Integer.parseInt(parts[0]);
                int y = Integer.parseInt(parts[1]);
                int r = Integer.parseInt(parts[2]);
                circles[i] = new Circle(new Point(x, y), r);
            }

            Set<Point> allPoints = new TreeSet<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = i + 1; j < n; j++) {
                    List<Point> inter = intersect(circles[i], circles[j]);
                    if (inter != null) {
                        allPoints.addAll(inter);
                    }
                }
            }

            Map<Point, Integer> pointIdMap = new TreeMap<>();
            List<List<Integer>> adjacency = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                List<Double> angles = new ArrayList<>();
                for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++) {
                    angles.add(2 * Math.PI * k / 3);
                }
                for (Point p : allPoints) {
                    if (circles[i].contains(p)) {
                        double dx = p.x - circles[i].o.x;
                        double dy = p.y - circles[i].o.y;
                        double alpha = Math.atan2(dy, dx);
                        if (alpha < 0) alpha += 2 * Math.PI;
                        angles.add(alpha);
                    }
                }
                Collections.sort(angles);
                Point dir = new Point(1, 0).scale(circles[i].r);
                Double[] sortedAngles = new TreeSet<>(angles).toArray(new Double[0]);
                for (Double a : sortedAngles) {
                    Point p = circles[i].o.add(dir.rotate(a));
                    getId(p, pointIdMap, adjacency);
                }
                for (int j = 0; j < sortedAngles.length; j++) {
                    Point p1 = circles[i].o.add(dir.rotate(sortedAngles[j]));
                    Point p2 = circles[i].o.add(dir.rotate(sortedAngles[(j + 1) % sortedAngles.length]));

                    if (u != v) {
                        adjacency.get(u).add(v);
                        adjacency.get(v).add(u);
                    }
                }
            }

            int vCount = adjacency.size();
            int eCount = 0;
            for (List<Integer> adjList : adjacency) {
                eCount += adjList.size();

            eCount /= 2;

                    components++;
                    dfs(i, visited, adjacency);
                }
            }

                }
            }

class GeometrySolver {
    final double TOLERANCE = 1e-8;

    public void solve(BufferedReader br, PrintWriter pw) throws IOException {
        int n = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
        Circle[] circles = new Circle[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String[] parts = br.readLine().split(" ");
            int x = Integer.parseInt(parts[0]);
            int y = Integer.parseInt(parts[1]);
            int r = Integer.parseInt(parts[2]);
            circles[i] = new Circle(new Point(x, y), r);
        }

        Set<Point> points = new TreeSet<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = i + 1; j < n; j++) {
                List<Point> inters = circleCircleIntersection(circles[i], circles[j]);
                if (inters != null) points.addAll(inters);
            }
        }

        Map<Point, Integer> pointIndices = new TreeMap<>();
        List<List<Integer>> graph = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            List<Double> angles = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++) {
                angles.add(2 * Math.PI * k / 3);
            }
            for (Point p : points) {
                if (circles[i].contains(p)) {
                    double dx = p.x - circles[i].o.x;
                    double dy = p.y - circles[i].o.y;
                    double a = Math.atan2(dy, dx);
                    if (a < 0) a += 2 * Math.PI;
                    angles.add(a);
                }
            }
            Collections.sort(angles);
            Point baseDir = new Point(1, 0).scale(circles[i].r);
            Double[] sortedAngles = new TreeSet<>(angles).toArray(new Double[0]);
            for (Double a : sortedAngles) {
                Point p = circles[i].o.add(baseDir.rotate(a));
                assignPointId(p, pointIndices, graph);
            }
            for (int j = 0; j < sortedAngles.length; j++) {
                Point p1 = circles[i].o.add(baseDir.rotate(sortedAngles[j]));
                Point p2 = circles[i].o.add(baseDir.rotate(sortedAngles[(j + 1) % sortedAngles.length]));
                int u = pointIndices.get(p1);
                int v = pointIndices.get(p2);
                if (u != v) {
                    graph.get(u).add(v);
                    graph.get(v).add(u);
                }
            }
        }

        int vCount = graph.size();
        int eCount = 0;
        for (List<Integer> list : graph) eCount += list.size();
        eCount /= 2;

        int componentCount = 0;
        boolean[] visited = new boolean[vCount];
        for (int i = 0; i < vCount; i++) {
            if (!visited[i]) {
                componentCount++;
                dfs(i, visited, graph);
            }
        }

        pw.println(1 + componentCount + eCount - vCount);
    }

    private void dfs(int u, boolean[] visited, List<List<Integer>> adj) {
        visited[u] = true;
        for (int v : adj.get(u))
            if (!visited[v]) dfs(v, visited, adj);
    }

    private void assignPointId(Point p, Map<Point, Integer> map, List<List<Integer>> adj) {
        if (!map.containsKey(p)) {
            int id = map.size();
            map.put(p, id);
            adj.add(new ArrayList<>());
        }
    }

    private List<Point> circleCircleIntersection(Circle c1, Circle c2) {
        double dx = c1.o.x - c2.o.x;
        double dy = c1.o.y - c2.o.y;
        double d = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
        double cosA = (c1.r * c1.r + d * d - c2.r * c2.r) / (2 * c1.r * d);
        if (cosA < -1 - TOLERANCE || cosA > 1 + TOLERANCE) return null;
        if (cosA < -1) cosA = -1;
        if (cosA > 1) cosA = 1;
        double alpha = Math.acos(cosA);
        Point dir = c2.o.sub(c1.o).norm();
        List<Point> res = new ArrayList<>();
        res.add(c1.o.add(dir.scale(c1.r).rotate(+alpha)));
        res.add(c1.o.add(dir.scale(c1.r).rotate(-alpha)));
        return res;
    }

    static class Point implements Comparable<Point> {
        double x, y;

        Point(double x, double y) {
            this.x = x;
            this.y = y;
        }

        Point add(Point o) { return new Point(x + o.x, y + o.y); }
        Point sub(Point o) { return new Point(x - o.x, y - o.y); }
        Point rotate(double a) {
            double c = Math.cos(a), s = Math.sin(a);
            return new Point(x * c - y * s, x * s + y * c);
        }
        Point scale(double f) { return new Point(x * f, y * f); }
        Point norm() {
            double len = length();
            if (len < 1e-14) return new Point(0, 0);
            return scale(1.0 / len);
        }
        double length() { return Math.hypot(x, y); }

        public int compareTo(Point o) {
            if (Math.abs(x - o.x) > 1e-14) return x < o.x ? -1 : 1;
            if (Math.abs(y - o.y) > 1e-14) return y < o.y ? -1 : 1;
            return 0;
        }

        public boolean equals(Object o) {
            if (!(o instanceof Point)) return false;
            Point p = (Point) o;
            return Math.abs(x - p.x) < 1e-8 && Math.abs(y - p.y) < 1e-8;
        }

        public int hashCode() {
            return Objects.hash(x, y);
        }

        public String toString() {
            return String.format("%.6f %.6f", x, y);
        }
    }

    static class Circle {
        Point o;
        double r;

        Circle(Point o, double r) {
            this.o = o;
            this.r = r;
        }

        boolean contains(Point p) {
            return Math.abs(p.sub(o).length() - r) < 1e-8;
        }
    }
}
